nodes.description:
A data-driven, stateless/controlled tree component. The consuming application
owns the `nodes` data (the single source of truth) and the controlled
`selectedNodeId` / `expandedNodeIds` state. The component renders the tree and
emits `nodeSelect` / `nodeExpandChange`; the application decides whether to
apply the change and passes the updated state back in.

props.name: allowDragDrop
props.description: Enables drag-and-drop reordering and reparenting via a per-row drag handle (shown on hover). After a successful drop the component emits `nodeMove` on `dragend`; the application applies it (e.g. via `moveNodeRelative`) and passes updated `nodes` back in.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Indicates that the content tree should have a border.

props.name: checkedNodeIds
props.description: The ids of the checked leaf nodes (multi-select). Controlled by the consuming application.

props.name: customClass
props.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the host element.

props.name: editingNodeId
props.description: The id of the node currently rendered as an inline editable input. Controlled by the consuming application (typically set in response to `nodeEdit`, `nodeAdd`, or `nodeDuplicate`).

props.name: expandedNodeIds
props.description: The ids of the currently expanded nodes. Controlled by the consuming application.

props.name: filter
props.description: When set, only nodes whose label matches (and their ancestors) are shown. Matching is a case-insensitive substring; matched parents reveal their full subtree. When `searchable` is enabled, this only seeds the built-in search box's initial value.

props.name: nodes
props.description: The tree data. The single source of truth, owned by the consuming application.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Shows a built-in search box above the tree that filters nodes internally (self-managed). When enabled, the search box owns the active filter and the `filter` prop is used only to seed its initial value.

props.name: selectedNodeId
props.description: The id of the currently selected (active) node. Controlled by the consuming application.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: The selection mode of the content tree.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the content tree items.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Configures the optional toolbar rendered above the tree. When set, a toolbar is shown with the enabled controls: an expand-all / collapse-all toggle and a delete button (enabled only when nodes are checked in multi-select).

events.name: expandAllChange
events.description: Event emitted when the toolbar's expand-all / collapse-all toggle is clicked. The app should set `expandedNodeIds` to every expandable id (e.g. via `getExpandableNodeIds`) when `expanded` is `true`, or to `[]` when `false`.

events.name: nodeAdd
events.description: Event emitted when "Add New Above/Below" or "Add Child Node" is chosen. The app should insert a node at the requested position and set `editingNodeId` to the new id.

events.name: nodeCheckChange
events.description: Event emitted when a checkbox is toggled (multi-select). The consuming application should update `checkedNodeIds`.

events.name: nodeDelete
events.description: Event emitted after the user confirms deletion. The app should remove the node from `nodes`.

events.name: nodeDuplicate
events.description: Event emitted when "Duplicate" is chosen. The app should clone the node below it and set `editingNodeId` to the new id.

events.name: nodeEdit
events.description: Event emitted when "Edit name" is chosen. The app should set `editingNodeId` to this id.

events.name: nodeEditCancel
events.description: Event emitted when an inline edit ends without an effective change — via Escape, or Enter/blur while the draft matches the original label. The app should clear `editingNodeId` (and discard a freshly added node if its name is still empty).

events.name: nodeExpandChange
events.description: Event emitted when a node's expansion is toggled. The consuming application should update `expandedNodeIds`.

events.name: nodeLoadChildren
events.description: Event emitted the first time a lazy node (`hasChildren: true` with no `children` yet) is expanded. The app should fetch the node's children and assign them to `nodes` (use `[]` when there are none); the component shows a spinner until `children` is defined.

events.name: nodeMove
events.description: Event emitted after a successful drag-and-drop, once the gesture ends (`dragend`). Emitting on `dragend` (not `drop`) keeps the drag source in the DOM until the browser finishes the gesture, so applying the move (e.g. via `moveNodeRelative`) cannot tear down the handle mid-drag. `position` is relative to `targetId`: `before`/`after` reorder among the target's siblings; `inside` nests the node as the target's first child.

events.name: nodeRename
events.description: Event emitted when an inline edit is committed with an effective label change (via Enter or losing focus). The app should apply the new label and clear `editingNodeId`.

events.name: nodesDelete
events.description: Event emitted when the toolbar's delete button is confirmed. `ids` are the top-most checked nodes; the app should remove them (e.g. via `deleteNodes`).

events.name: nodeSelect
events.description: Event emitted when a node is selected. The consuming application should update `selectedNodeId`.

events.name: nodeVisibilityChange
events.description: Event emitted when a node's visibility (eye) toggle is clicked. `disabled` is the new state. The app should update the node's own `disabled` state (e.g. via `setNodeDisabled`); descendants become effectively disabled via ancestor inheritance.

nodes.description:
A customizable date picker component used to create date inputs.

Adheres to WCAG 2.2 standards.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Indicates that the input should have a border.

props.name: customClass
props.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the input.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the form control is disabled.

props.name: endValue
props.description: The end date in range mode (`type="range"`). Must match the `format` prop pattern (or the locale-derived format when unset) or ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Empty string when unset. Ignored in single mode.

props.name: feedback
props.description: Feedback to render below the input.

props.name: format
props.description: The date format for display and input.

props.name: hideOverflowDates
props.description: When omitted, defaults to `true` in range mode and `false` in single mode.

props.name: inputId
props.description: The ID of the start input in single mode. In range mode, the end input id is `{inputId}-end` (or `{generated-id}-end` when omitted). There is no separate prop for the end input id.

props.name: inputTabIndex
props.description: Determine the control's relative ordering for sequential focus navigation (typically with the Tab key).

props.name: label
props.description: The text to display within the label.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum date value. Must match the `format` prop pattern (or the locale-derived format when unset) or ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum date value. Must match the `format` prop pattern (or the locale-derived format when unset) or ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the form control. In range mode, the end input name is `{name}-end`. There is no separate prop for the end input name.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the value is editable.

props.name: required
props.description: A value is required or must be checked for the form to be submittable.

props.name: showWeekNumbers
props.description: Displays ISO 8601 week numbers in the calendar. Week numbers are calculated with Monday as the first day of the week.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the input.

props.name: type
props.description: Activates range mode. `value` is the start date; `endValue` is the end date.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected date in single mode. In range mode (`type="range"`), the start date of the range. Must match the `format` prop pattern (or the locale-derived format when unset) or ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Empty string when unset.

props.name: weekStartDay
props.description: The first day of the week for the calendar display

events.name: calendarMonthChange
events.description: Event emitted when the start (or single-mode) calendar month selection changes.

events.name: calendarYearChange
events.description: Event emitted when the start (or single-mode) calendar year selection changes.

events.name: endCalendarMonthChange
events.description: Event emitted when the end calendar month selection changes in range mode.

events.name: endCalendarYearChange
events.description: Event emitted when the end calendar year selection changes in range mode.

events.name: inputBlur
events.description: Event emitted when the input loses focus. In range mode, `detail.field` is `'start'` or `'end'`.

events.name: inputChange
events.description: Event emitted when the input value changes. `target.value` is always ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), or empty string when incomplete or invalid. In range mode, `detail.field` is `'start'` or `'end'`.

events.name: inputFocus
events.description: Event emitted when the input gains focus. In range mode, `detail.field` is `'start'` or `'end'`.

events.name: rangeChange
events.description: Event emitted when a complete date range is selected in range mode.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the input.

props.name: step
props.description:
Specifies the granularity that the `value` must adhere to.
Value of step given in seconds. Default value is 60 seconds.
Overrides the `seconds` attribute if both are provided.

props.name: value
props.description:
The value of the time input.
Always in 24-hour format that includes leading zeros:
`HH:mm` or `HH:mm:ss`, regardless of input format which is likely
to be selected based on user's locale (or by the user agent).
If time includes seconds the format is always `HH:mm:ss`.

events.name: inputBlur
events.description: Event emitted when the input loses focus.

events.name: inputChange
events.description: Event emitted when the input value changes.

events.name: inputFocus
events.description: Event emitted when the input gains focus.

The component supports a `<slot>` for injecting additional custom content inside the toast.

props.name: customClass
props.description: Additional classes for custom styling.

props.name: delay
props.description: Time taken to dismiss the toast in milliseconds

props.name: position
props.description: The position of the toast in the parent container.

nodes.description:
A customizable toolbar component used to organize content across the entire page.

This component provides 'start', 'center', and 'end' `<slot>` elements for inserting custom HTML.

props.name: customClass
props.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the outer div.

nodes.description:
A customizable tooltip component used to create tooltips with different content.

The tooltip opens on hover and keyboard focus of the wrapped trigger, and closes on
pointer leave, focus leave, or Escape (without moving focus). When forceOpen is enabled,
the tooltip remains open and Escape does not dismiss it.
Use the contentElement prop to supply rich HTML content to the tooltip such as multiline text.
For plain dynamic text, prefer the content prop instead. When contentElement is set, it takes precedence over the content prop.

For screen reader support, set `tooltip-id` on this component and matching `aria-describedby`
on the trigger (e.g. modus-wc-button).

props.name: content
props.description: The text content of the tooltip. When contentElement is also set, contentElement takes precedence.

props.name: contentElement
props.description:
An optional rich HTML element to render as the tooltip body.
When set, this takes precedence over the `content` string prop.
The element is deep-cloned into the tooltip container.

props.name: customClass
props.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the inner div.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables displaying the tooltip on hover and focus

props.name: forceOpen
props.description: Use this attribute to force the tooltip to remain open.

props.name: position
props.description: The position that the tooltip will render in relation to the element.

props.name: tooltipId
props.description:
The ID of the tooltip tip element (`role="tooltip"`).
For screen reader support, add `aria-describedby` with this value to your trigger element.

events.name: dismissEscape
events.description: An event that fires when the tooltip is dismissed via Escape key

nodes.description:
A customizable tree item component used to display the item portion of a tree menu.

This component supports `start` and `end` slots for custom content at the beginning and end of the item.

props.name: blockExpand
props.description: When true, prevents the built-in inline submenu toggle on click. The item will only emit `itemSelect` so the consumer can handle the expansion externally (e.g. show a flyout panel). Only has an effect when `hasSubmenu` is also true.

props.name: checkbox
props.description: If true, renders a checkbox at the start of the tree item.

props.name: customClass
props.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the li element.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The disabled state of the tree item.

props.name: focused
props.description: The focused state of the tree item.

props.name: hasSubmenu
props.description: Whether this tree item has a collapsible submenu. When true, the item will show a caret and handle toggle behavior.

props.name: label
props.description: The text rendered in the tree item.

props.name: selected
props.description: The selected state of the tree item.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the tree item.

props.name: subLabel
props.description: The text rendered beneath the label.

props.name: tooltipContent
props.description: The tooltip text to display when hovering over the tree item.

props.name: tooltipPosition
props.description: The position of the tooltip relative to the tree item.

props.name: value
props.description: The unique identifying value of the tree item.

events.name: itemSelect
events.description: Event emitted when a tree item is selected.

nodes.description:

props.name: bordered

props.name: customClass

props.name: isSubMenu
props.description: Indicates that this tree menu is a submenu (dropdown).

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the tree menu.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: The selection mode of the tree menu.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the tree menu.

events.name: menuFocusout
events.description: Event emitted when the tree menu loses focus.

events.name: menuSelectionChange
events.description: Event emitted when the selection changes in multiple selection mode. Emits the array of currently selected tree item elements.

nodes.description:
A customizable typography component used to render text with different sizes, hierarchy, and weights.

Note:
- When using heading elements (h1-h6), the default heading CSS styling can be accessed without modifying
the default size (size="md") and weight (weight="normal") properties. Default styling can be overridden by
providing your own custom values for the size or weight properties from the available options.


- If both slot content and `label` are provided, only the slot content will be rendered
- Use the `label` prop when you need to dynamically update the text.

props.name: customClass
props.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the typography element.

props.name: hierarchy
props.description: The hierarchy of the typography component.

props.name: label
props.description: The text label to display.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the font.

props.name: weight
props.description: The weight of the text.

props.name: backgroundOverlay
collapseOnClickOutside

props.name: customClass
props.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the outer div.

props.name: expanded

props.name: pushContent

props.name: targetElement
props.description: Target element reference to push content when panel opens

events.name: panelClosed

events.name: panelOpened
